{{TAG:0003:002A:}}{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} heißt dich immer

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Hee hee hee. It's still early here in
{{TAG:0005:0005:}}, and my hands are

{{TAG:0005:0007:}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'adore l'hiver, je m'amuse trop !

{{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0005:0005:}} e mi si sono già

DE:
{{TAG:0003:0024:}}Hehehe, hier in {{TAG:0005:0005:}} ist es

ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Eh! Me alegro de volver a verte.
{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}¿Qué tal aguantas el frío?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0013:}}¡Yo no lo soporto!
{{TAG:0003:0003:}}Pero me deja las mejillas de color

rosse troppo carine!

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heey! Seni yine görmek güzel!
{{TAG:0007:0000:0F000000}}Soğuk diye aklın dağılıp gitmiyor ya,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
değil mi?{{TAG:0003:001F:}} Bu buz gibi sızıyı aşacaksın,
{{TAG:0005:0007:}}! {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Hem değiyor; soğuk yanakları

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wow, and here you are again!
Wait, wait, don't tell me. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}I look like
a snow princess, right? {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Thanks!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ya veo que sigues por aquí.
No digas nada. {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}Ya sé que parezco
una princesa de las nieves. {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡Gracias!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ehi, rieccoti qui!
Di' un po':{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} con tutta 'sta neve

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Wow, da bist du ja schon wieder!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0010:}}

EN:
Yay! We meet again! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0011:}}But wait!
Where did you go? Everything's

OK, blink it out, {{TAG:0005:0001:}}...
Warm up the peepers...{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Whew. All good again!

FR:
Hé, kikou toi ! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Holà, trop bizarre...

{{TAG:0005:0001:}} !!! Cligner des yeux !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}J'oublie tout le temps, je suis

Ehi! Ci rivediamo! {{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0011:}}Oh, ma che fine
